topics.name: Automation Enable, Disable and Pause
topics.purpose: Define automation lifecycle state independently from installed/defined schedule/action semantics.

semantics.enable_rule: Enable targets exact automation definition and validates dependencies/bindings.
semantics.disable_rule: Disable prevents future dispatch but does not rewrite prior occurrence/execution history.
semantics.pause_rule: Pause semantics for due occurrences are explicit.
semantics.retire_rule: Retired automation remains historical definition evidence.
semantics.schedule_rule: Defined schedule existence never implies enabled automation.
semantics.authority_rule: Lifecycle changes require explicit automation-admin authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
